meta_description:
1,827 likes, 130 comments - kaisafit on October 13, 2026: "If you are ready to get back into movement, I highly suggest you worry LESS about the specific program and more about the schedule.

My biggest goal right now is keeping a time commitment to myself. What I do during that time doesn’t really matter because the goal is simply creating a new routine and sticking with it.

That’s it. That’s step one. Look at your schedule, figure out how many days a week you can move and for how long and then commit to showing up for every single one of those sessions.

What you do during those workouts is FAR less important right now, we’ll get to that in a month or so. But for now, schedule & show up. That’s the goal, that’s the win. We got this! Go Team gooooo 🫶".
